metadata.title: AI Video Studio Workspace
metadata.description: A focused production workspace for drafting, organizing, and iterating AI video clips in Happy Horse AI.

header.title: AI Video Studio
header.description: Use one focused studio to draft shots, scan inspiration, and review your latest renders without leaving the page.
header.note: This first release is UI-only and currently runs with mock data.

workspace.promptRequired: Please provide a prompt before submitting.
workspace.helper: Tip: start with one clear action + camera instruction, then refine style details in the next pass.

statuses.completed: Task completed. Check History for latest output.
statuses.failed: Task failed. Review the error and retry.
